app.title: ClassBridge
app.subTitle: Connecting Classrooms
app.privacyNotice: Notice: Real student names, school names, student IDs, and photos are neither collected nor stored.
app.firebaseConfigNotice: Firebase configuration required. Please add VITE_FIREBASE_* in .env.local. (Running in Local Demo Mode)

roles.teacherDesc: Check asynchronous progress and manage process-based assessment records
roles.studentDesc: Safely participate in cultural missions with code and English nickname

start.welcome: Asynchronous International Classroom Exchange between Korea & Taiwan
start.selectRole: Please select your role to enter

studentJoin.title: Join ClassBridge Room
studentJoin.instructions: Enter your participant code and English nickname. Your partner class is automatically identified from your code.
studentJoin.warning: Warning: Do not enter your real name or school name. Never share your private code with others.

studentActivity.title: Choose Your Favorite Keyring Design
studentActivity.desc: Vote for the commemorative keyring design created by both classes and express your reasons in English!
studentActivity.step2: 2. Click a sentence frame to write your reason
studentActivity.reasonPlaceholder: Select a sentence frame and complete the blank...
studentActivity.submittedDesc: Explore the voting results and public comments from partner students.
studentActivity.commentPlaceholder: Leave a kind, encouraging, or helpful comment.
studentActivity.commentMaskedNotice: This comment is being reviewed by a teacher for safe exchange.
studentActivity.qaReplyPlaceholder: Write a kind and detailed response in English...
studentActivity.pasteWarningNotice: This activity encourages writing your own sentences. If needed, ask your teacher to allow pasting.
studentActivity.friendlyGuidanceNotice: ※ Your submission will be shared with friends after teacher safety review.
studentActivity.noSubmissionsNotice: No submissions yet. Be the first to share your thoughts!
studentActivity.teacherOnlyViewNotice: This activity is set to be viewed by teachers only.
studentActivity.reviewingNotice: Under teacher review. (Will be safely shared with friends once approved)
studentActivity.maskedPostNotice: Under teacher review for safe cultural exchange.
studentActivity.helpDeclarationTitle: ✍️ Select the tools or help you used for this writing:
studentActivity.helpDeclarationNotice: ※ Using help tools does not lower your score; honest disclosure helps your teacher provide tailored guidance.
studentActivity.titlePlaceholder: e.g. My Favorite Spot in Seoul
studentActivity.translationPlaceholder: Optional English translation for your partner classmates...
studentActivity.selectAtLeastOneOption: Please select at least one option.
studentActivity.partnerOnlyReplyAlert: Only partner students can reply to this question.

teacher.evalNotice: Reference assessment statement is not an automatic grading; teachers must verify and edit before use.
teacher.noSubmissions: No submissions found matching the criteria.
teacher.privateNoteHidden: ※ Private notes and assessment statements are strictly hidden from students.

submissionDetail.title: Student Submission Details
submissionDetail.phraseNotice: Reference statement is not an automatic grading; teachers must verify and edit before use.

activity.cannotDeleteNotice: Activities with student records cannot be deleted. Archive the activity to preserve assessment evidence.
activity.deleteWarning: This action cannot be undone. Only draft activities with 0 submissions, comments, and votes can be deleted. Type the exact activity title below to confirm.
activity.futurePhotoNotice: Student photo attachments will be available later with teacher approval for privacy protection.
activity.fallbackNotice: Translation unavailable. Showing the original text.
activity.archivedListDesc: These activities are hidden from default views and can be restored at any time. Only empty drafts can be permanently deleted.

admin.title: Minimal Service Admin Console
admin.notice: This console is for service administrators only and is not visible to general users.
admin.restrictedNotice: This area is accessible to authorized service administrators only. Administrator authentication will be enabled after Firebase connection.
